effects.effect: As a [free maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/free-maneuver), you can spend 1d6 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) to remove one effect on you. Each creature of your choice in the area of your [Null Field](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/null-field) ability also gains this benefit.
